title: Korean-Style Spicy Salmon Rice Bowl
summary: A fast pescatarian dinner bowl with flaky salmon glazed in a spicy-savoury Korean-inspired chilli sauce, served over rice with cool cucumber and creamy avocado. It is fresh, filling and punchy, ideal for a weeknight dinner.

ingredients.name: vegetable stock, for cooking the rice
sriracha, as a spicy Korean-style chilli sauce substitute

steps: Put the rinsed sushi rice in a small saucepan with the vegetable stock, or cook according to your rice cooker instructions. Bring to a boil, cover, reduce the heat to low and cook for 12 minutes, then turn off the heat and leave covered for 10 minutes until tender and sticky.
Meanwhile, mix the tamari, sriracha, sesame oil, rice vinegar, brown sugar, garlic and ginger in a bowl to make a spicy glaze.

Pat the salmon dry and season with a pinch of salt. Heat the vegetable oil in a non-stick frying pan over medium-high heat. Cook the salmon for 3–4 minutes on the first side until browned, then turn and cook for 2–3 minutes more until just cooked through and flaky.
Pour the spicy glaze into the pan and spoon it over the salmon for 1–2 minutes until glossy and slightly thickened. Break the salmon into large flakes.
Divide the rice between two bowls. Top with the glazed salmon, cucumber slices, avocado and spring onions.
Sprinkle with sesame seeds and spoon over any remaining glaze from the pan. Serve immediately while the salmon and rice are warm and the vegetables are cool and crisp.
